# Microsoft 365 Copilot release notes

<!-- This page is updated monthly. -->

## October 2026

### Notebooks in Copilot Chat

Copilot Notebooks are now available in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Notebooks collect pages, files and chats about one topic.

- Available on web and desktop.
- **Rolling out** to all users over the coming weeks.

### Agent Builder improvements

Agent Builder now lets makers add a SharePoint site as knowledge with a [new picker](https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/agent-builder?utm_campaign=rn). Requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

## September 2026

### Copilot in Outlook summarizes threads in more languages

Thread summaries in Outlook now support Danish, Norwegian and Swedish. This update is available in the EU Data Boundary.
